nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Ordinary squared residuals provide an adequate measurement model for the spiked training trace.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Across three grid densities, ordinary least squares gave 12.18–12.38% public stress error while spike-clipped refits gave 0.35–0.36%.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Sparse spikes dominate the squared loss and shift the inferred relaxation spectrum, even with affine drift included.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Keep affine drift and positive moduli, reject spikes robustly before refitting, and diagnose the remaining equilibrium error separately.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Exact hereditary dynamics and affine drift removal suffice to identify the equilibrium modulus to 6% on this loading history.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Training-only fits at equilibrium moduli 9.83 and 13.30 raised chi-square by only 1.70 and 3.56, respectively; their 6% tolerance intervals are disjoint.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The slowest relaxation mode exchanges stress with the elastic term and the fitted drift; observed stress alone constrains that combination better than its components.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Keep the exact forward model and test weak regularization of relative spectral shape against the unregularized fit on both separated and uneven spectra.
